tool_args.rationale: Use all seven paid rows to numerically fit the shared siphon base with signed square-root branch over the specified wide fallback parameter bounds. The prior attempt failed because its predict function expected a returned predictor; this implementation stores fitted parameters for the required predict(row) interface.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The paid wide-s_grad probe resolves the stated narrow-s_grad identifiability issue; no further probe is needed before fitting.
The observed response increases monotonically and concavely over u_now, with additional s_grad-dependent changes inconsistent with a u-only declining high-substrate curve.
The observed s_grad values are at or below 2.35, below the specified supercritical regime; the threshold mechanism is not implicated.
